outline:
介紹各種能源的來源及應用技術，包括化石燃料、核能、太陽能、風能、地熱、水力發電與海洋能、生質能、氫能、儲能和節能技術的應用。
This course introduces the sources of various energy and their application technologies, including fossil fuels, nuclear energy, solar energy, wind energy, geothermal energy, hydropower and ocean energy, biomass energy, hydrogen energy, energy storage, and energy-saving technologies.
